title: eslint-plugin-nuxt is deprecated
summary: npm marks eslint-plugin-nuxt as deprecated: "eslint-plugin-nuxt was built for Nuxt 2. Use @nuxt/eslint-plugin instead: https://eslint.nuxt.com/packages/plugin"

constraints: Keep the Nuxt-specific lint rules and options the project currently enables.

steps.title: Replace the plugin package
steps.instructions: Replace eslint-plugin-nuxt with @nuxt/eslint-plugin in devDependencies and in the ESLint configuration.

steps.title: Port the enabled rules
steps.instructions: Move the enabled Nuxt rules and their options into the configuration shape the new plugin expects.

verification.purpose: Run the linter with the new plugin and compare the findings.
